title: Pelican-Sim 1.0: A General World Model Simulator for Embodied Intelligence
summary: In this technical report, we propose Pelican-Sim 1.0, a general world model simulator for embodied intelligence that predicts future observations from visual context and robot actions to support downstream learning and decision making. The model incorporates four key design features: (1) Unified action representation: a 28-dimensional action value space covering most mainstream embodiments, keeping one model valid across heterogeneous devices. (2) Action-visual injection: URDF- and camera-rendered action videos bridge actions and pixels, giving markedly better controllability across embodiments, scenes, and tasks (PSNR +0.904 over alternative fusion baselines). (3) Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE): sparse MoE layers add capacity for heterogeneous dynamics and absorb the action modality while reducing inter-modality conflict (FVD -6.530 vs. the dense backbone). (4) Efficient rollout generation: causal adaptation and few-step distillation yield a four-step autoregressive simulator, achieving a 5.67-fold speedup over the 35-step model. Benefiting from these designs, we train on approximately one million real-world and simulated trajectories and obtain large gains in action controllability and video quality: PSNR improves over the strongest evaluated baselines by 4.636 on AgiBotWorld Beta, 2.080 on RoboMIND, and 10.343 on RoboTwin, with the adapted EWMBench DYN score up 0.426 on RoboTwin. Relying on this, four downstream applications on RoboTwin succeed: 500 generated trajectories added to 50 demonstrations per task raise policy success from 70% to 93%; policy evaluation reaches a Pearson correlation of 0.994 across five checkpoints; and relative success gains reach 47.7% for action selection and 20.3% for policy improvement. Qualitative generalization across trajectory, scene, object, embodiment, and viewpoint shifts highlights its potential as a general-purpose world model simulator.
tldr: Pelican-Sim 1.0 is a general world model simulator for embodied intelligence that predicts future observations from visual context and robot actions, featuring unified action representation, action-visual injection, sparse mixture-of-experts, and efficient rollout generation. It demonstrates strong action controllability and video quality, and supports downstream applications like policy training and evaluation.
tldr_zh: Pelican-Sim 1.0 是一个面向具身智能的通用世界模型模拟器，从视觉上下文和机器人动作预测未来观测，具备统一动作表示、动作-视觉注入、稀疏专家混合和高效滚动生成等特点。它在动作可控性和视频质量上表现优异，并支持策略训练与评估等下游应用。
summary_zh: 在本技术报告中，我们提出了Pelican-Sim 1.0，一种面向具身智能的通用世界模型模拟器，从视觉上下文和机器人动作预测未来观测，以支持下游学习与决策。该模型包含四项关键设计：（1）统一动作表示：覆盖大多数主流具身形态的28维动作值空间，使同一模型在异构设备间保持有效性。（2）动作-视觉注入：基于URDF和相机渲染的动作视频桥接动作与像素，在多种具身形态、场景和任务中显著提升可控性（相比其他融合基线PSNR提升0.904）。（3）稀疏专家混合（MoE）：稀疏MoE层增加异构动力学建模容量，并吸收动作模态，同时降低模态间冲突（FVD较稠密骨干下降6.530）。（4）高效轨迹生成：因果适配和少步蒸馏实现了四步自回归模拟器，相比35步模型获得5.67倍加速。得益于上述设计，我们在约一百万条真实和仿真轨迹上进行训练，在动作可控性和视频质量方面取得了显著提升：在AgiBotWorld Beta上PSNR较最强评估基线提升4.636，在RoboMIND上提升2.080，在RoboTwin上提升10.343，同时EWMBench DYN得分在RoboTwin上提升0.426。基于此，我们在RoboTwin上的四项下游应用取得成功：每任务在50条示范基础上增加500条生成轨迹，将策略成功率从70%提升至93%；策略评估在五个检查点间达到0.994的皮尔逊相关系数；在动作选择和政策改进中相对成功率增益分别达到47.7%和20.3%。在轨迹、场景、物体、具身形态和视角变化上的定性泛化结果凸显其作为通用世界模型模拟器的潜力。

title: 2AM: Grounding Agent-Side Memory as Guidance for Steerable Action Models in Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires memory, but not necessarily inside the action policy. To address such tasks, current agentic systems often combine VLAs with planners and geometric tools, sometimes using additional depth or calibrated geometry. These systems confound attribution: gains may come from richer observations or alternative motor tools, while failures may stem from either the policy or an under-specified language interface. We isolate this question through a deliberately constrained design: less tool breadth, but greater interface bandwidth. 2AM makes a multimodal Agent the sole holder of task memory and a single RGB-based, episodically stateless Action Model the sole executor of task-relevant motion. The Agent compiles interaction history into subtask language and optional 2D grasp, place, and move hints that bind its physical intention at different time scales. To teach this steerability to the VLA, we augment demonstrations with structured hint labels and train under condition dropout, spatial noise, and temporal jitter to tolerate imperfect Agent outputs. On LIBERO-Mem, without depth, online geometry, or planner-based object motion, 2AM reaches 76.3% average completion, a 61.5-point improvement over the strongest reported baseline of 14.8%, together with 63.0% relaxed and 11.8% strict success. These results show that task memory can remain Agent-side. They further show that Action Model capability depends not only on what the policy has learned, but on how precisely the Agent can steer it.
tldr: This paper introduces 2AM, a system that keeps task memory in a multimodal agent rather than the action policy, using subtask language and 2D hints to steer a stateless VLA policy, achieving significant improvements on LIBERO-Mem.
tldr_zh: 本文提出2AM系统，将任务记忆保留在多模态智能体中，通过子任务语言和2D提示来引导无状态VLA策略，在LIBERO-Mem上取得了显著提升。
summary_zh: 长视野机器人操作需要记忆，但这种记忆不一定必须存在于动作策略内部。为应对此类任务，当前的智能体系统常将视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）与规划器及几何工具结合，有时还依赖额外的深度信息或标定几何。这类系统混淆了归因：性能提升可能源于更丰富的观测或替代性运动工具，而失败则可能归因于策略本身或语言接口定义不充分。我们通过一种刻意受限的设计来隔离这一问题：减少工具广度，但增大接口带宽。2AM将多模态智能体（Agent）作为任务记忆的唯一持有者，并将基于单目RGB、无跨回合状态的单一动作模型（Action Model）作为任务相关运动的唯一执行者。智能体将交互历史编译为子任务语言及可选的2D抓取、放置和移动提示，这些提示在不同时间尺度上绑定其物理意图。为教会VLA这种可引导性，我们用结构化提示标签扩充演示数据，并在条件丢弃、空间噪声和时间抖动下进行训练，以容忍不完美的智能体输出。在LIBERO-Mem基准上，无需深度信息、在线几何或基于规划器的物体运动，2AM达到了76.3%的平均完成率，较已有最强基线14.8%提升了61.5个百分点，同时实现了63.0%的宽松成功率和11.8%的严格成功率。这些结果表明，任务记忆可以保留在智能体一侧，并进一步说明动作模型的能力不仅取决于策略已学习到的内容，还取决于智能体对其引导的精确程度。

title: IMLE-VLA: Fast Single-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language backbones to achieve strong cross-task generalization. A leading design couples this backbone with a dedicated continuous action head trained via diffusion or flow matching. However, such heads rely on iterative multi-step sampling, for example 10 Euler steps in $π_{0.5}$. This creates an inference bottleneck that produces stop-and-go movement in the robot and slower task completion. We introduce IMLE-VLA, which replaces the iterative action head with a single-step conditional generator trained via conditional Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (cIMLE). The cIMLE objective promotes multimodal action coverage, avoiding the mode collapse of naive regression heads while eliminating multi-step sampling entirely. When IMLE-VLA is applied to $π_{0.5}$, it increases inference frequency 3.67x (55 Hz vs. 15 Hz), enabling up to 11x higher action throughput. On the 40-task LIBERO benchmark, IMLE-VLA achieves the highest average success rate (98.0%) among all baselines while leading in inference frequency. Under the test-time perturbations of LIBERO-plus, IMLE-VLA retains $π_{0.5}$'s robustness while other baselines degrade sharply, confirming that the cIMLE head preserves generalization. Real-world experiments on a Franka Emika Panda across four tasks demonstrate smoother motion (2.2x to 3.0x lower jerk) and faster task completion, with IMLE-VLA outperforming $π_{0.5}$ on every task and reducing average VLA inference time per episode by 3.9x to 6.6x. Videos and code are available at https://kianhk6.github.io/IMLE-VLA/
tldr: IMLE-VLA replaces the iterative diffusion/flow-matching action head in VLA policies with a single-step conditional implicit maximum likelihood estimation generator, boosting inference frequency and smoothness while preserving or improving success rates on LIBERO and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: IMLE-VLA 用基于条件隐式最大似然估计的单步生成器替代 VLA 策略中的迭代扩散/流匹配动作头，显著提高推理频率和动作平滑度，并在 LIBERO 和真实机器人任务上保持或提升成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略利用预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络，实现了强大的跨任务泛化能力。一种主流设计将该骨干网络与专门的连续动作头相结合，并通过扩散或流匹配进行训练。然而，此类动作头依赖于迭代式多步采样，例如在$π_{0.5}$中需要10步欧拉法求解。这造成了推理瓶颈，导致机器人运动出现走走停停的现象，并延长了任务完成时间。我们提出了IMLE-VLA，将迭代式动作头替换为通过条件隐式最大似然估计（cIMLE）训练的单步条件生成器。cIMLE目标函数促进了多模态动作覆盖，既避免了朴素回归头可能出现的模式坍塌问题，又完全消除了多步采样。将IMLE-VLA应用于$π_{0.5}$后，推理频率提高了3.67倍（从15 Hz提升至55 Hz），动作吞吐量最高可提升11倍。在包含40个任务的LIBERO基准测试中，IMLE-VLA在所有基线方法中取得了最高的平均成功率（98.0%），同时在推理频率方面也处于领先地位。在LIBERO-plus的测试时扰动条件下，IMLE-VLA保持了$π_{0.5}$的鲁棒性，而其他基线方法的性能则大幅下降，这证实了cIMLE动作头能够保持泛化能力。在Franka Emika Panda机器人上进行的四项真实世界实验表明，IMLE-VLA实现了更平滑的运动（冲击度降低2.2倍至3.0倍）和更快的任务完成速度，在每项任务上均优于$π_{0.5}$，并将每回合的平均VLA推理时间缩短了3.9倍至6.6倍。视频和代码可在https://kianhk6.github.io/IMLE-VLA/获取。

title: HuRo: Robotizing Human Videos for Scalable VLA Pretraining
summary: Human video datasets have emerged as a compelling alternative to expensive real-robot data, offering rich diversity at scale. To bridge the human-to-robot embodiment gap, existing approaches either robotize videos in task-matched settings or address observation and action alignment separately at scale. In this work, we systematically examine whether robotized human videos can provide effective and scalable supervision for pretraining vision-language-action (VLA) policies. To this end, we develop a robotization pipeline that converts heterogeneous human videos into robot-aligned observations and action trajectories while inferring missing intermediate signals across annotation levels. Using this pipeline, we construct the HuRo dataset, comprising about 630K robotized episodes and 142M processed frames from five human-video sources. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, increasing robotized pretraining scale improves overall completion from 51.5% to 80.3% and OOD completion under spatial and visual shifts from 34.9% to 72.2%. Ablations further show that visual robotization improves OOD robustness and that end-to-end pretraining with retargeted actions outperforms visual-only transfer. Project website: https://3587jjh.github.io/HuRo.
tldr: This paper introduces a pipeline to robotize heterogeneous human videos into robot-aligned observations and action trajectories, constructing a large-scale HuRo dataset (630K episodes) and demonstrating that increasing pretraining scale on this data improves real-world VLA manipulation performance and OOD robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种将异构人类视频转换为机器人对齐的观测和动作轨迹的流水线，构建大规模HuRo数据集（63万条片段），并证明在该数据上增加预训练规模可提升真实世界VLA操作性能及分布外鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 人类视频数据集已成为昂贵的真实机器人数据的一种极具吸引力的替代方案，能够以规模化方式提供丰富的多样性。为弥合从人类到机器人的具身差异，现有方法要么在任务匹配场景中对视频进行“机器人化”处理，要么在大规模上分别解决观测对齐与动作对齐问题。在本工作中，我们系统性地考察了机器人化的人类视频能否为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的预训练提供有效且可扩展的监督信号。为此，我们开发了一套机器人化流水线，可将异构人类视频转换为与机器人对齐的观测和动作轨迹，同时在不同标注层级上推断缺失的中间信号。利用该流水线，我们构建了HuRo数据集，包含来自五个来源的约63万条机器人化片段及1.42亿帧处理后的图像。在四个真实世界操作任务中，增大机器人化预训练的规模使整体完成率从51.5%提升至80.3%，并在空间和视觉偏移下的分布外（OOD）完成率从34.9%提升至72.2%。消融实验进一步表明，视觉机器人化可增强OOD鲁棒性，而采用重定向动作的端到端预训练优于仅做视觉迁移的方案。项目主页：https://3587jjh.github.io/HuRo。

title: UniMPA: A Unified Memory-Prediction-Action Model via Action-Grounded Transition Modeling
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have improved robotic manipulation, yet observation-to-action learning remains limited by a fundamental transition realizability gap, manifested in three tightly coupled problems: (i) Transition ambiguity. Visually similar current observations may correspond to different manipulation phases and imply different subsequent transitions. (ii) Prediction--execution mismatch. A visually plausible predicted future observation does not necessarily correspond to a physically realizable transition. (iii) Experience--realization mismatch. A historically executable action pattern may not necessarily realize the intended transition in the current scene and therefore requires context-aware adaptation. Accordingly, we propose UniMPA, a Unified Memory-Prediction-Action model that addresses these problems through a shared action-grounded transition interface. (i) UniMPA introduces Persistent-Selective Future Prediction to resolve transition ambiguity by modeling the intended future state evolution. A persistent latent stream continuously tracks task-level progress, while a transition-critical pixel stream selectively resolves fine-grained interaction changes through memory-grounded prediction. (ii) To assess the physical executability of the anticipated transition, the predicted transition queries a temporal Visual-Action Memory Bank. The bank retrieves historically realized visual-action experience, grounding future prediction in executable evidence. (iii) To adapt executable experience to the current scene, an Action-Visual Memory Bank retrieves visually grounded action prototypes from historical action evolution. Prototype-Biased Flow then shifts the flow source toward a historically supported action manifold for context-aware refinement.
tldr: UniMPA is a unified memory-prediction-action model for robotic manipulation that addresses transition ambiguity, prediction-execution mismatch, and experience-realization mismatch via a shared action-grounded transition interface with persistent-selective future prediction and dual visual-action memory banks.
tldr_zh: UniMPA 是一个用于机器人操作的统一记忆-预测-动作模型，通过共享的动作基础转换接口、持久选择性未来预测和双视觉-动作记忆库，解决了转换歧义、预测-执行不匹配以及经验-实现不匹配问题。
summary_zh: 近期视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的进展提升了机器人操作能力，然而从观察到动作的学习仍受限于一个基本转换可实现性差距，表现为三个紧密耦合的问题：（i）转换歧义。视觉上相似的当前观察可能对应不同的操作阶段，并暗示不同的后续转换。（ii）预测与执行不匹配。视觉上合理的预测未来观察并不一定对应物理上可实现的转换。（iii）经验与现实不匹配。历史上可执行的动作模式在当前场景中不一定能实现预期转换，因此需要依赖上下文的自适应调整。为此，我们提出UniMPA，一个统一的记忆-预测-动作模型，通过共享的基于动作的转换接口解决上述问题。（i）UniMPA引入持久-选择性未来预测，通过建模预期未来状态演化来消除转换歧义。持久潜在流持续跟踪任务级进展，而转换关键像素流通过记忆接地预测选择性解析细粒度交互变化。（ii）为评估预期转换的物理可执行性，预测转换查询时间视觉-动作记忆库。该记忆库检索历史上已实现的视觉-动作经验，将未来预测锚定于可执行的证据之上。（iii）为使可执行经验适应当前场景，动作-视觉记忆库从历史动作演化中检索视觉接地的动作原型。原型偏置流随后将流源移向历史支持的动作流形，以实现上下文感知的精细调整。

title: Rapid Learning of Dexterous In-Hand Pen Writing through Real-Time Jacobian Estimation
summary: Dexterous in-hand manipulation of a grasped object with an anthropomorphic hand is an unsolved frontier for robot dexterity. The contact-richness and highly dynamic nature of object-hand interactions tend to require extensive modeling or data-collection efforts for learning-based approaches. Modern simulators used for reinforcement learning (RL) cannot fully replicate the required contact complexity, while collecting dexterous demonstrations for imitation learning (IL) remains an open problem. In this research, we present an embodied control approach based on real-time task Jacobian estimation of the combined hand and object system on the physical robot. Using only the CPU on a laptop, the proposed controller begins in-hand pen writing after approximately 18 s of initialization and continues to adapt online, without an analytic hand--object kinematic/contact model, simulation training, or precollected task demonstrations. We demonstrate that the same estimator/controller formulation works on three anthropomorphic robotic hand systems (one physical, two simulated) to show human-like, in-hand articulation of a grasped pen by an embodiment-independent formulation. Sub-millimeter in-plane precision (mean 0.6 mm across runs) is achieved across letters and shapes written in the air and on paper on a physical robot. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an anthropomorphic hand writing arbitrary single-stroke trajectories with a grasped pen through purely in-hand motion, and it showcases an alternative to compute- and data-heavy approaches such as RL and IL for achieving dexterous manipulation through computationally simple and data-efficient algorithms.
tldr: This paper presents a computationally simple, data-efficient embodied control approach for dexterous in-hand pen writing on anthropomorphic hands, using real-time task Jacobian estimation without analytic models, simulation, or demonstrations, and demonstrates sub-millimeter precision on a physical robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于实时任务雅可比估计的具身控制方法，用于拟人手上的灵巧笔书写，无需解析模型、仿真或演示，并在物理机器人上实现了亚毫米级精度。
summary_zh: 灵巧地在手中操纵一个被类人手机抓取的物体，是机器人灵巧性领域尚未解决的前沿问题。物体与手交互过程中的高接触密集性和高度动态性，往往要求基于学习的方法进行大量建模或数据采集工作。用于强化学习（RL）的现代模拟器无法完全复现所需的接触复杂性，而采集用于模仿学习（IL）的灵巧示范仍是一个未解难题。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于实时任务雅可比估计的具身控制方法，该方法在物理机器人上对手与物体组合系统进行实时任务雅可比估计。该控制器仅使用笔记本电脑上的CPU，在约18秒的初始化后即可开始手中书写钢笔字，并持续在线适应，无需解析手-物体运动学/接触模型、无需仿真训练、也无需预采集的任务示范。我们证明了相同的估计器/控制器公式可应用于三种类人机器人手系统（一个物理系统，两个模拟系统），展示了与具体实现无关的公式如何实现对手中抓握钢笔的类人关节运动。在物理机器人上的空中和纸上书写中，平面内精度达到亚毫米级（各次运行平均误差0.6毫米）。据我们所知，这是首次示范类人手仅通过手中运动即可用抓握的笔书写任意单笔划轨迹，展示了一种通过计算简单且数据高效的算法实现灵巧操作的替代路径，有别于RL和IL等计算密集和数据密集的方法。

title: SEED-UMI: Sharing the Exoskeleton between human and robot for onE-to-one Dexterous demonstration
summary: Imitation learning for dexterous hands is bottlenecked by the difficulty of collecting contact-rich demonstrations that transfer faithfully to the robot. Prior wearable-exoskeleton systems record only on the human side and retarget via open-loop mappings calibrated in free space, which degrade under contact. We present SEED-UMI, a framework in which both the human and the robot wear the same exoskeleton: joint encoders become a physically shared measurement, and wrist cameras mounted to the exoskeleton observe the same outer mechanism during both human data collection and robot policy rollouts. This turns retargeting into paired cross-embodiment supervision and lets policies train directly on raw exoskeleton-centric wrist images, without segmentation or inpainting. On five contact-rich tasks, SEED-UMI achieves 3.0x greater data collection efficiency than exoskeleton-based teleoperation and a 70.0% average rollout success rate.
tldr: SEED-UMI introduces a shared-exoskeleton framework where human and robot wear the same device, enabling paired cross-embodiment supervision and raw wrist-camera training for dexterous manipulation, achieving higher data efficiency and rollout success on contact-rich tasks.
tldr_zh: SEED-UMI 提出一种人机共享外骨骼框架，使人类和机器人佩戴相同设备，通过配对跨具身监督和原始腕部相机训练，在接触丰富的灵巧操作任务中实现更高数据效率和成功率。
summary_zh: 模仿学习在灵巧手操作中遇到瓶颈，主要困难在于收集能够忠实迁移到机器人的接触丰富演示数据。此前的可穿戴外骨骼系统仅记录人体侧数据，并通过在自由空间中校准的开环映射进行重定向，在接触情况下性能会下降。我们提出SEED-UMI框架，在该框架中，人类和机器人佩戴相同的外骨骼：关节编码器成为物理共享的测量装置，同时安装在外骨骼上的腕部摄像头在人类数据采集和机器人策略执行过程中观察到相同的外部机制。这将重定向问题转化为跨实体配对监督，使得策略可以直接基于以原始外骨骼为中心的腕部图像进行训练，无需分割或修复处理。在五个接触丰富的任务中，SEED-UMI相比基于外骨骼的遥操作实现了3.0倍的数据采集效率提升，且平均执行成功率达到70.0%。

title: MC-DeTra: Motion-Consistent Joint Object Detection and Socially-Aware Trajectory Forecasting in Bird's-Eye-View Images
summary: Unified models for object detection and trajectory forecasting aim to merge perception and prediction for autonomous driving, refining actor trajectories directly over shared bird's-eye-view (BEV) images rasterized from LiDAR and high-definition maps. Their accuracy on dynamic, moving actors, however, remains the hardest part of the task, and the strongest such model, DeTra, has no public implementation. We contribute an openly released DeTra reimplementation with documented approximations, and on top of it MC-DeTra: a family of motion-consistency mechanisms that add supervision through two annotation-derived auxiliary signals -- each actor's observed past motion and the occupancy of the surrounding traffic that forms its social context -- and one inter-output consistency constraint that aligns an actor's predicted heading with its predicted direction of motion. Every proposed loss is train-only and inference-safe: it shapes the shared BEV representation during training and is removed at test time, adding no inference latency. On the Waymo Open Dataset, evaluated under a strict, detection-conditioned forecasting protocol, MC-DeTra improves dynamic, socially-situated trajectory forecasting while preserving or improving detection accuracy; a gradient-based loss-calibration analysis exposes how the auxiliary objectives compete at the shared backbone, and our ablation identifies which signals contribute most. We release code, configurations, and evaluation tooling at https://github.com/diuzhevVlad/MC-DeTra.
tldr: MC-DeTra presents motion-consistency auxiliary losses and a reimplementation of DeTra for unified BEV object detection and socially-aware trajectory forecasting in autonomous driving, improving dynamic actor forecasting on Waymo Open Dataset without inference cost.
tldr_zh: MC-DeTra 提出了运动一致性辅助损失，并重新实现了 DeTra，用于自动驾驶中的 BEV 目标检测和社会感知轨迹预测，在 Waymo 数据集上提升了动态目标的预测精度且无推理开销。
summary_zh: 统一的目标检测与轨迹预测模型旨在融合自动驾驶中的感知与预测模块，直接在由激光雷达和高精地图栅格化得到的共享鸟瞰图（BEV）上优化智能体的轨迹。然而，这类模型对动态、移动智能体的预测精度仍是任务中最具挑战性的部分，而目前性能最强的此类模型DeTra并未公开实现。我们贡献了一个公开发布的DeTra复现版本，并记录了其中的近似处理；在此基础上，我们提出了MC-DeTra：一系列运动一致性机制，通过两种由标注派生的辅助信号——每个智能体观测到的历史运动及其周围交通占用情况（构成其社会上下文）——以及一种输出间一致性约束（将智能体的预测航向与其预测运动方向对齐）来添加监督。所有提出的损失函数仅用于训练且对推理安全：它们在训练过程中塑造共享BEV表示，在测试时被移除，不增加任何推理延迟。在Waymo开放数据集上，按照严格的、基于检测条件设定的预测协议进行评估，MC-DeTra在提升动态、社会情境化轨迹预测性能的同时，保持或提升了检测精度；基于梯度的损失校准分析揭示了辅助目标如何在共享主干网络中存在竞争，而我们的消融实验则识别出哪些信号贡献最大。我们在 https://github.com/diuzhevVlad/MC-DeTra 发布了代码、配置和评估工具。

title: ActSafeGuard: Differentiable and Training-Aligned Constraint Enforcement for Flow-Matching Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet their generated actions may violate hard physical constraints and therefore be unsafe or infeasible for deployment. Existing safety approaches either optimize statistical safety objectives without deterministic per-step guarantees or correct unsafe actions only during inference, creating a mismatch between policy training and execution. We introduce ActSafeGuard, a differentiable and training-aligned safeguard layer for flow-matching based policies. ActSafeGuard integrates hard action feasibility into policy learning, not merely treating safety as an inference-time external component. Through an analytical ray-scaling operator design, ActSafeGuard enables boundary-aware gradients to guide the model to naturally learn constrained manifolds. Extensive experiments on multiple standard foundation backbones ($π_{0.5}$ and Fast-WAM) across various tasks demonstrate that ActSafeGuard consistently achieves a $100\%$ step safety rate while fully preserving or even boosting task success rates, providing a scalable and minimally invasive solution for safe embodied AI deployment.
tldr: ActSafeGuard introduces a differentiable, training-aligned safeguard layer for flow-matching policies in robotic manipulation, enforcing hard constraints during training and achieving 100% step safety across VLA and World-Action backbones.
tldr_zh: ActSafeGuard 为流匹配策略引入可微、训练对齐的安全保障层，在训练中强制执行硬约束，并在VLA和世界动作模型上实现100%的步骤安全率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）与世界-动作模型（WAMs）在通用机器人操作任务中展现出强大的能力，然而其生成的动作为满足硬物理约束，可能导致部署时不安全或不可行。现有安全方法要么优化统计意义上的安全目标，而缺乏确定性的逐步骤保障，要么仅在推理阶段修正不安全动作，造成策略训练与执行之间的不一致。我们提出ActSafeGuard，一种面向基于流匹配策略的可微分且与训练对齐的安全防护层。ActSafeGuard将硬动作可行性融入策略学习过程，而非仅将安全视为推理阶段的外部组件。通过解析性的射线缩放算子设计，ActSafeGuard能够提供边界感知的梯度，引导模型自然地学习约束流形。在多个标准基础骨干模型（\( \pi_{0.5} \)与Fast-WAM）上的大量跨任务实验表明，ActSafeGuard能够持续实现\( 100\% \)的逐步骤安全率，同时完全保持甚至提升任务成功率，为安全的具身智能部署提供了一种可扩展且最小侵入性的解决方案。

title: Contact-Aware Incremental Model Predictive Control for an Underactuated Aerial Manipulator
summary: We present a robust contact-aware control framework for aerial writing on an underactuated platform. The framework combines nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) for accurate end-effector position and normal-force tracking at small reference penetration depths, with consistent performance across controller tunings, with whole-body incremental nonlinear dynamic inversion (INDI) for robustness to frictional and aerodynamic disturbances during contact. The proposed controllers are validated on a quadrotor-based aerial manipulator with a rigid, single-link, one-degree-of-freedom (DoF) arm in simulation and real-world experiments. The aerial writing experiments span vertical and inclined surfaces, multiple reference forces, different friction conditions, and wind disturbances. The results demonstrate that robust simultaneous five-DoF end-effector pose and contact-force tracking is achievable on a standard underactuated quadrotor with a simple, rigid, single-link arm, without requiring a fully actuated platform, a complex arm, or dedicated force/torque sensing.
tldr: This paper introduces a contact-aware control framework combining NMPC and INDI for aerial writing with an underactuated quadrotor-based manipulator, validated in simulation and real-world experiments for pose and force tracking.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合NMPC和INDI的接触感知控制框架，用于欠驱动四旋翼机械臂的空中书写，并在仿真和实际实验中验证了位姿与力跟踪。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种针对欠驱动平台上的空中书写任务的鲁棒接触感知控制框架。该框架结合了非线性模型预测控制（NMPC），用于在小参考穿透深度下实现精确的末端执行器位置和法向力跟踪，并在不同控制器调参下保持一致的性能；同时，结合全身增量非线性动态反演（INDI），以增强对接触过程中摩擦力和气动扰动的鲁棒性。所提出的控制器在基于四旋翼的空中机械臂上进行了仿真和实际实验验证，该机械臂配备刚性单连杆、单自由度（DoF）手臂。空中书写实验涵盖了垂直和倾斜表面、多种参考力、不同摩擦条件以及风扰动场景。结果表明，在标准欠驱动四旋翼平台上，仅使用简单、刚性的单连杆手臂，即可实现末端执行器五自由度位姿与接触力的鲁棒同步跟踪，无需全驱动平台、复杂机械臂或专用力/力矩传感器。

title: Memory as Plans: World-Action Modeling with Memory-Grounded Planning
summary: Mainstream robotic policies often adopt a Markovian formulation, but many complex real-world manipulation tasks are inherently non-Markovian, requiring long-horizon memory beyond the current observation. Existing memory mechanisms often rely on language summaries, growing visual windows, or their combinations, and may therefore lose fine-grained visual evidence or face a trade-off between history coverage and execution efficiency. We introduce MaP-WAM, a Memory-as-Plans framework that decomposes memory-dependent world-action modeling into memory-grounded planning and plan-conditioned execution, and uses long-term multimodal episodic context as planning-time evidence rather than repeatedly conditioning the executor on the full history. MaP-WAM represents memory as completed segment records containing language instructions and sparse visual context, and converts this episodic memory into compact plans comprising the next segment-level language plan and corresponding visual guidance. A World-Action-Progress (WAP) model executes each plan over an unknown duration by jointly predicting action chunks and corresponding execution progress at inference time, calibrating predicted progress through plan-observation alignment for adaptive segment transitions and closed-loop context updates. MaP-WAM keeps the executor context length fixed, while structured attention further enables key-value caching in both planning and execution. MaP-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on RMBench with an 83.3% success rate and attains 78.0% success on real-robot tasks, while maintaining approximately constant executor inference latency as task history grows.
tldr: MaP-WAM decomposes memory-dependent manipulation into memory-grounded planning and plan-conditioned execution, using long-term multimodal episodic context as planning-time evidence to keep executor context fixed and achieve state-of-the-art results on RMBench and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: MaP-WAM 将依赖记忆的操作任务分解为基于记忆的规划和基于计划的执行，利用长期多模态情景上下文作为规划时证据，在保持执行器上下文长度固定的同时，在RMBench和真实机器人任务上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 主流机器人策略通常采用马尔可夫公式化，但许多复杂的现实世界操作任务本质上是非马尔可夫的，需要在当前观测之外具备长时程记忆能力。现有的记忆机制往往依赖于语言摘要、不断增长的视觉窗口或其组合，因此可能丢失细粒度的视觉证据，或在历史覆盖范围与执行效率之间面临权衡。我们提出了MaP-WAM，一种“记忆即计划”（Memory-as-Plans）框架，将依赖记忆的世界-动作建模分解为基于记忆的规划和基于计划的执行，并利用长期多模态情景上下文作为规划时的证据，而非反复以完整历史来调节执行器。MaP-WAM将记忆表示为包含语言指令和稀疏视觉上下文的已完成片段记录，并将这种情景记忆转换为紧凑计划，该计划包含下一层级的语言计划及相应的视觉引导。一个世界-动作-进度（WAP）模型通过联合预测动作块及推理时的相应执行进度来执行每个计划，持续时长未知，并通过计划-观测对齐来校准预测进度，从而实现自适应的片段转换和闭环上下文更新。MaP-WAM保持执行器上下文长度固定，同时结构化注意力机制进一步在规划和执行阶段启用键值缓存。MaP-WAM在RMBench上取得了83.3%的成功率，达到当前最优性能，并在真实机器人任务中实现了78.0%的成功率，同时随着任务历史的增长，执行器推理延迟基本保持恒定。

title: CAP: Continuously Adaptive Perception-Blind Humanoid Locomotion via Learned Denoising
summary: Humanoid locomotion across complex terrain demands forward-looking exteroception to anticipate obstacles, yet this signal is unreliable in real-world deployment, failing partially and intermittently. Existing perceptive policies often assume that depth observations remain clean and in-distribution, while recent attempts to unify perceptive and blind control typically route or switch between separate sub-policies, leaving recoverable information in partially corrupted depth unexploited. We instead propose CAP, a single-stage humanoid locomotion policy that recovers this signal with a perceptive world-model encoder trained as a learned denoiser to reconstruct clean depth from a corrupted input, together with a co-active proprioceptive variational encoder that supplies depth-free body-state information. A coupled training recipe pairs a depth-noise curriculum on the world-model input with world-model feature dropout on the policy-facing latent, exposing the policy to failures across the entire perception-quality spectrum. In simulation, CAP matches or improves upon perceptive baselines when depth remains informative, and degrades more smoothly than a binary-switching baseline as perception worsens. On the Unitree G1, controlled trials and indoor-outdoor deployments demonstrate perception-robust locomotion under intermittent occlusion, real-sensor corruption, and outdoor depth artifacts.
tldr: CAP proposes a single-stage humanoid locomotion policy that uses a perceptive world-model encoder trained as a learned denoiser to reconstruct clean depth from corrupted inputs, alongside a co-active proprioceptive variational encoder, enabling robustness to partial and intermittent perception failures on real robots.
tldr_zh: CAP提出了一种单阶段人形运动策略，利用训练为学习去噪器的感知世界模型编码器从受损深度输入中重建干净深度，并协同使用本体感觉变分编码器，从而在真实机器人上实现对部分和间歇性感知失败的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 行走于复杂地形的人形机器人需要前瞻性外部感知来预判障碍，然而该信号在实际部署中并不可靠，会部分且间歇性地失效。现有感知策略通常假设深度观测保持干净且分布内一致，而近期尝试统一感知与盲控的方法往往在各自分离的子策略间进行路由或切换，未能充分利用部分受损深度中仍可恢复的信息。为此，我们提出CAP，一种单阶段人形行走策略，通过一个感知世界模型编码器恢复该信号，该编码器作为学习型去噪器，从受损输入中重建干净深度，并协同一个无深度的本体感觉变分编码器提供身体状态信息。联合训练方案将世界模型输入上的深度噪声课程与面向策略潜在特征上的世界模型特征丢弃相结合，使策略在整个感知质量谱系中暴露于各类失效情形。在仿真中，当深度信息仍具价值时，CAP达到或超越感知基线性能，并且随着感知质量下降，其退化比二元切换基线更为平滑。在Unitree G1上，受控实验与室内外部署验证了在间歇性遮挡、真实传感器损坏及户外深度伪影情况下的感知鲁棒行走能力。

title: IMM-based Multiple Object Tracking using a State Prediction Neural Network
summary: Object tracking is essential for autonomous vehicles to avoid obstacles and plan routes. Radar maintains detection performance even in adverse weather and can measure relative velocity through the Doppler effect, making it well suited for object tracking. In this paper, we propose a data-driven state PRedictor-based Interacting Multiple Model tracking method (PR-IMM) that improves nonlinear object-motion representation while preserving the stability and interpretability of physics-based motion models. The proposed method employs a transformer-based PRediction model (PR) that incorporates radar Doppler measurements to predict object displacement. The PR model is integrated into the IMM as a mode alongside the CV, CA, and CT motion models, and their prior positions are dynamically combined according to the mode probabilities. Experimental results show that PR-IMM reduces position-estimation error by 57.3% over the IMM and by 16.5% over the PR, while reducing ID switches by 25.3% and improving IDF1 by 9.6% over the IMM.
tldr: This paper proposes PR-IMM, a hybrid tracking method that integrates a transformer-based prediction model with radar Doppler measurements into an Interacting Multiple Model framework, improving position estimation and reducing ID switches for autonomous vehicle object tracking.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PR-IMM，一种将基于Transformer的预测模型与雷达多普勒测量结合到交互式多模型框架中的混合跟踪方法，用于自动驾驶车辆目标跟踪，提高了位置估计精度并减少了ID切换。
summary_zh: 目标跟踪对于自动驾驶车辆避开障碍物和规划路线至关重要。雷达即使在恶劣天气下也能保持检测性能，并能通过多普勒效应测量相对速度，因此非常适合目标跟踪。本文提出了一种基于数据驱动状态预测器的交互式多模型跟踪方法（PR-IMM），该方法在保持基于物理的运动模型的稳定性和可解释性的同时，改进了非线性目标运动表征。所提方法采用基于变换器的预测模型（PR），该模型融合雷达多普勒测量值来预测目标位移。PR模型作为模式之一被集成到IMM中，与CV、CA和CT运动模型并列，并根据模式概率动态组合各模型的先验位置。实验结果表明，与IMM相比，PR-IMM将位置估计误差降低了57.3%，与PR相比降低了16.5%；同时，与IMM相比，ID切换次数减少了25.3%，IDF1提升了9.6%。

title: FARM: Reading Failure Signals from the Internal Predictive States of a Frozen Robotic World Model
summary: Reliable robot deployment requires online failure monitoring, yet existing monitors mainly derive risk from proxy signals or train dedicated monitoring components. We ask whether the internal predictive states of a frozen pretrained robotic world model already contain directly decodable failure information. Failure-Aware Readout from World Models (FARM) trains only a 33,985-parameter supervised readout over frozen VLA-JEPA predictive states, producing step-wise failure scores and causal trajectory risk. Five-fold out-of-fold evaluation across seven source tasks reaches 85.68/88.59 pooled AUROC/AUPRC, and FARM gives the best Seen performance among 15 matched baselines on the 10-task benchmark. Across four real-robot populations on PIPER X, SO-101, and Franka, fixed-readout transfer and readout-only adaptation test deployment shifts without updating the predictive backbone. FARM also discriminates failures from partial causal histories and adds 0.2256 ms mean CUDA latency once the frozen state is available. These results support frozen predictive world-model states as reusable features for causal, transferable, and low-overhead execution monitoring.
tldr: FARM trains a small readout over frozen VLA-JEPA world model predictive states to detect robot execution failures, showing transferable and low-latency failure monitoring across simulated and real robot tasks.
tldr_zh: FARM 在冻结的 VLA-JEPA 世界模型预测状态上训练一个小型读出器，以检测机器人执行失败，并在模拟和真实机器人任务中展示了可迁移和低延迟的失败监控能力。
summary_zh: 可靠的机器人部署需要在线故障监测，然而现有监测手段主要从代理信号推导风险，或训练专门的监测组件。我们探究一个冻结的预训练机器人世界模型的内部预测状态是否已经包含可直接解码的故障信息。世界模型故障感知读出（FARM）在冻结的VLA-JEPA预测状态之上仅训练一个包含33，985个参数的监督读出器，从而生成逐步故障评分和因果轨迹风险。在七个源任务上的五折样本外评估达到了85.68/88.59的合并AUROC/AUPRC，并且在10任务基准上，FARM在15个匹配基线中取得了最佳的“已见”性能。在PIPER X、SO-101和Franka上的四个真实机器人群体中，固定读出迁移和仅读出适配测试了部署偏移，而无需更新预测主干网络。FARM还能从部分因果历史中区分故障，并且在冻结状态可用后，平均CUDA延迟仅增加0.2256毫秒。这些结果表明，冻结的预测世界模型状态可作为可复用的特征，用于因果性、可迁移且低开销的执行监测。

title: Safety-aware Skill Adaptation for Reinforcement Learning in Dynamic Environments
summary: Skill adaptation frameworks based on reinforcement learning often require restrictive assumptions to maintain stability, such as fixed observations or tightly controlled exploration schedules. In cluttered and dynamic environments, however, unrestricted exploration can lead to unsafe behaviour and unstable learning, particularly when task-relevant observations lie near obstacles or involve moving objects. In this work, we present Dist-GPRL, a distance-aware and safety-guided reinforcement learning framework for structured robot skill adaptation. Building upon Gaussian Process (GP)-based skill parameterisation, our framework sequentially adapts overlapping local windows of sparse trajectory via-points rather than modifying the complete skill at every policy step. Raw policy outputs are correlated through the GP covariance structure, producing temporally coherent trajectory updates while reducing the action-space and credit-assignment difficulties associated with global trajectory adaptation. Safety is incorporated through two complementary forms of guidance. A safe-subspace prior derived from the Hausdorff Approximation Planner (HAP) biases policy exploration toward feasible regions, while dynamically updated distance field clearance and gradient rewards provide local obstacle awareness. A trajectory-kinematics similarity regulariser further preserves the demonstrated velocity and acceleration characteristics during adaptation. We evaluate the framework on two dynamic object-manipulation tasks in simulation and transfer the learned policy to real-world robot execution. Experimental results demonstrate higher task success, lower collision frequency, and more stable learning than the baselines, while preserving the kinematic characteristics of the demonstrated skill.
tldr: This paper introduces Dist-GPRL, a reinforcement learning framework for robot skill adaptation that uses Gaussian Process-based trajectory parameterization, safe-subspace priors from a planner, and distance-field-based rewards to ensure safe and stable learning in dynamic environments, demonstrated in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Dist-GPRL，一种用于动态环境中机器人技能适应的强化学习框架，通过高斯过程轨迹参数化、规划器安全子空间先验和距离场奖励，确保学习的安全性和稳定性，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 基于强化学习的技能适应框架通常需要严格的假设来维持稳定性，例如固定的观测或严格控制探索的调度机制。然而，在杂乱且动态的环境中，无约束的探索可能导致不安全的行为和不稳定的学习，尤其是当与任务相关的观测位于障碍物附近或涉及移动物体时。在本工作中，我们提出了Dist-GPRL，一种面向结构化机器人技能适应的距离感知与安全引导强化学习框架。该框架基于高斯过程（GP）技能参数化，通过序贯地适应稀疏轨迹路点上的重叠局部窗口来更新技能，而非在每次策略步骤中修改整个技能。原始策略输出通过GP协方差结构相关联，从而生成时间上连贯的轨迹更新，同时降低了与全局轨迹适应相关的动作空间规模和信用分配难度。安全性通过两种互补的引导形式得以实现：由Hausdorff近似规划器（HAP）导出的安全子空间先验将策略探索偏向可行区域，而动态更新的距离场间隙及梯度奖励则提供局部障碍感知。此外，轨迹-运动学相似性正则化器在适应过程中保持示范的速率和加速度特性。我们在两个动态物体操作任务中进行了仿真评估，并将学习到的策略迁移至真实机器人执行。实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，所提框架在任务成功率、碰撞频率降低以及学习稳定性方面均表现更优，同时保留了示范技能的运动学特征。

title: Beyond Noise Steering: Dual-Latent Space Reinforcement Learning for Generative Robot Policy
summary: Pretrained generative robot policies learn expressive action priors from demonstrations. However, existing reinforcement learning methods only steer the noisy space but fail to modulate intermediate action representations during the generation process, resulting in performance degradation and inefficiency. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Dual-Latent Space Reinforcement Learning (DLSRL) framework, which complements initial-noise steering with representation-level control inside the frozen generator. Specifically, our actor network predicts two distinct latent variables: an initial-noise latent variable that steers behavior generation, and an action-representation latent variable for intermediate feature modulation. Moreover, this representation latent variable is mapped to adapter features and ingeniously injected into the hidden states of intermediate action tokens via residual connections. Our dual-control design enables direct adjustment of action representations without updating the base policy. Experiments across generative policy architectures and robotic manipulation tasks show that DLSRL effectively accelerates online robot policy adaptation and achieves competitive performance. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/DLSRL}{https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/DLSRL}.
tldr: This paper proposes DLSRL, a dual-latent space reinforcement learning framework that enhances pretrained generative robot policies by adding representation-level control alongside initial-noise steering, accelerating online adaptation and improving performance on robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DLSRL，一种双潜空间强化学习框架，通过表示级控制补充初始噪声引导，加速预训练生成式机器人策略的在线自适应，并在操作任务上取得竞争性性能。
summary_zh: 预训练生成式机器人策略能够从示范中学习表达丰富的动作先验。然而，现有的强化学习方法仅能操控噪声空间，却未能在生成过程中对中间动作表征进行调节，导致性能下降和效率低下。为克服这一局限，我们提出了一种新颖的双潜空间强化学习（DLSRL）框架，该框架在冻结生成器内部，以表征级控制补充初始噪声引导。具体而言，我们的演员网络预测两个不同的潜变量：一个用于引导行为生成的初始噪声潜变量，以及一个用于中间特征调制的动作表征潜变量。此外，该表征潜变量被映射为适配器特征，并通过残差连接巧妙地注入到中间动作标记的隐藏状态中。我们的双控设计使得在不更新基础策略的情况下，能够直接调整动作表征。在多种生成式策略架构和机器人操作任务上的实验表明，DLSRL能够有效加速在线机器人策略适应，并实现具有竞争力的性能。我们的代码可在 \href{https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/DLSRL}{https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/DLSRL} 获取。

title: ObstaDiff: Generalizable Diffusion Policy Learning via Obstacle-aware Representations
summary: Imitation learning has achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation, yet most existing approaches assume clean backgrounds and lack explicit mechanisms for obstacle-aware motion generation. Extending such policies to cluttered, real-world scenes with unstructured obstacles remains a key generalization challenge. We present ObstaDiff, a decomposed diffusion-policy framework with a lightweight obstacle-aware visual encoder. ObstaDiff extracts a structured target-obstacle-background representation, enabling the downstream alignment policy to generate end-effector trajectories toward a target-centered bottleneck pose while reasoning about surrounding obstacles. We evaluate ObstaDiff on 61 real-robot greenhouse trials per method (366 executions in total). ObstaDiff achieves 75.41% average task success and 8.20% average obstacle collision rate, outperforming representative imitation-learning baselines and improving generalization in cluttered agricultural scenes.
tldr: ObstaDiff introduces a decomposed diffusion-policy framework with an obstacle-aware visual encoder that extracts target-obstacle-background representations, enabling generalizable manipulation in cluttered agricultural scenes. It demonstrates improved task success and reduced collision rates over baselines in 366 real-robot executions.
tldr_zh: ObstaDiff 提出了一种分解式扩散策略框架，配备轻量级障碍物感知视觉编码器，提取目标-障碍物-背景表示，从而在杂乱农业场景中实现可泛化的操作。在366次真实机器人执行中，相比基线方法，任务成功率提高且碰撞率降低。
summary_zh: 模仿学习在机器人操作领域取得了显著成果，然而现有方法大多假设环境背景干净，且缺乏针对障碍物感知的运动生成显式机制。将这些策略扩展到障碍物杂乱且非结构化的真实场景，仍然是一个关键性的泛化挑战。为此，我们提出了ObstaDiff，一种分解式扩散策略框架，配备了轻量级的障碍物感知视觉编码器。ObstaDiff提取结构化的目标-障碍物-背景表示，使下游的对齐策略能够生成朝向以目标为中心的瓶颈位姿的末端执行器轨迹，同时考虑周围障碍物信息。我们在每种方法61次真实机器人温室试验（总计366次执行）中对ObstaDiff进行了评估。ObstaDiff实现了75.41%的平均任务成功率和8.20%的平均障碍物碰撞率，优于具有代表性的模仿学习基线方法，并在杂乱农业场景中显著提升了泛化能力。

title: ReactHuman: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Human-Like Reactive Decision-Making in Embodied Multimodal LLMs
summary: Reacting to sudden physical hazards (catching a slipping plate, dodging a falling knife) is both a meaningful test of embodied intelligence and a hard requirement for deploying multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as the decision coreof household robots. Existing evaluations, however, probe intuitive physics passively through question answering over videos, or target deliberate, long-horizon tasks such as navigation and rearrangement; none measure whether a model can turn physical understanding into immediate, safety-critical action. We introduce ReactHuman, the first physics-grounded benchmark for human-like reactive decision-making, in which the evaluated MLLM acts as the brain of a simulated humanoid facing sudden household hazards; it spans 17 event families and over 1,000 bit-for-bit reproducible scenes with exact, annotation-free ground truth derived from 240 Hz rigid-body simulation, including adversarial objects whose appearance contradicts their physics (a foam anvil, a steel apple). We further design a five-metric suite that scores each reaction along three axes: reasonable, safe, and physically grounded. We physically execute every committed plan so that decisions have observable consequences. With this harness we evaluate seven representative MLLMs. Results show that reactive safety is far from solved: models mishandle roughly one hazard in three, act from fixed dispositions rather than the observed scene, trust appearance over motion, and miss interception points at meter scale even when the chosen action is correct; none of these failures shrink with model scale. ReactHuman thus offers both a fine-grained diagnosis and a scalable training signal toward physically grounded, safety-aware embodied agents. The benchmark can be found here: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Alan123/reacthuman-benchmark-scaled
tldr: ReactHuman is a physics-grounded benchmark for evaluating embodied multimodal LLMs on reactive, safety-critical decision-making tasks in a simulated humanoid, revealing significant shortcomings in current models' ability to act safely and physically grounded in dynamic hazard scenarios.
tldr_zh: ReactHuman 是一个基于物理的基准测试，用于评估具身多模态大模型在模拟人形机器人上的反应性、安全关键决策能力，揭示当前模型在动态危险场景中安全、物理合理行动方面的显著不足。
summary_zh: 对突发物理危险的响应（接住滑落的盘子、躲开下落的刀具）既是对具身智能的一项意义重大的测试，也是将多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）部署为家用机器人决策核心的硬性要求。然而，现有评估要么通过视频问答被动地探测直观物理理解，要么针对刻意的长周期任务（如导航和重新排列）进行测试；没有一项评估能衡量模型能否将物理理解转化为即时的、关乎安全的行动。我们引入了ReactHuman，这是首个面向类人反应式决策的、基于物理学的基准测试，其中被评估的MLLM充当面对突发家庭危险的仿真人形机器人的大脑；它涵盖17个事件族和超过1，000个逐位可复现的场景，并具有源自240 Hz刚体模拟的精确、无需标注的真相数据，包括外观与物理属性相矛盾的对抗性物体（泡沫铁砧、钢制苹果）。我们进一步设计了一套五指标评测体系，从三个维度对每个反应进行评分：合理性、安全性和物理依据性。我们实际执行每一个已承诺的计划，使决策具有可观察的后果。利用这一测试平台，我们评估了七个具有代表性的MLLM。结果表明，反应安全性远未解决：模型大约每三个危险中就有一个处理不当，行为基于固定倾向而非观察到的场景，信任外观而非运动，即使所选行动正确，拦截点误差也达到米级；这些失败均不随模型规模扩大而缩小。因此，ReactHuman为迈向具有物理依据、具备安全意识的具身智能体提供了细粒度的诊断和可扩展的训练信号。该基准可在以下网址获取：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Alan123/reacthuman-benchmark-scaled

title: Your Model Already Knows Don't Teach It, Learn to Ask It: Soft Prompting for Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary:
We address few-shot object detection with vision-language models (VLMs) in out-of-domain settings such as aerial, industrial, and medical imagery, using only ten annotated images for supervision. Existing adaptation methods are discrete prompt optimization and LoRA fine-tuning. We revisit a third option: soft prompting, where a small number of continuous prompt tokens are optimized while the pretrained backbone remains frozen.
  We identify two key design choices. First, placing prompt tokens at the cross-modal boundary between visual and text tokens outperforms other placements (10.0 vs. 8.4 mAP). Second, initializing prompts from the empty space token outperforms semantic and random initialization.
  With these choices, one to three learned tokens (7,168 parameters on average) match the best LoRA configuration on Roboflow20-VL (14.2 mAP, 10-shot) while training over 20,000x fewer parameters. Soft prompting remains harder to optimize, exhibiting higher variance across random seeds. Unlike LoRA, however, it causes no forgetting: the LoRA rank matching our accuracy reduces NaturalBench VQA accuracy by 35% relative, rising to 56% at the largest rank, whereas soft prompting leaves pretrained performance unchanged.
  The learned tokens behave like prompts rather than weights. They transfer to a newer model without retraining (+0.8 mAP on Qwen3.5-9B) and can be verbalized into readable prompts competitive with prompt-search methods (matching DetPO and outperforming GEPA).
  The approach also extends beyond detection. On RoboCasa manipulation tasks, the frozen $π_{0.5}$ vision-language-action policy benefits from soft prompting, matching the LoRA baseline on two of three tasks when tokens are placed at the gradient bottleneck. These results suggest modern VLMs already encode much of what is needed for specialized domains; the challenge is learning how to ask.
tldr: This paper revisits soft prompting for few-shot adaptation of vision-language models in out-of-domain detection, showing it matches LoRA performance with far fewer parameters and no forgetting, and extends to robotic manipulation tasks with a frozen VLA policy.
tldr_zh: 本文重新审视了软提示在少样本视觉语言模型适应中的应用，证明其在参数大幅减少且不遗忘的情况下匹配LoRA性能，并扩展到机器人操作任务。
summary_zh:
我们探讨了在域外场景（如航空、工业和医学影像）中，仅使用十张标注图像进行监督的少样本目标检测问题，并借助视觉-语言模型（VLMs）加以解决。现有的适应方法包括离散提示优化和LoRA微调。我们重新审视了第三种方案：软提示，即在预训练骨干网络保持冻结的情况下，优化少量连续提示令牌。
我们确定了两个关键设计选择。首先，将提示令牌置于视觉令牌与文本令牌之间的跨模态边界处，其表现优于其他位置（mAP 10.0对8.4）。其次，从空白空间令牌初始化提示，优于语义初始化和随机初始化。
基于这些选择，一至三个学习令牌（平均7，168个参数）在Roboflow20-VL数据集上（14.2 mAP，10样本）达到了最佳LoRA配置的性能，同时训练参数减少了超过20，000倍。软提示仍然较难优化，在不同随机种子间表现出较高的方差。然而，与LoRA不同，软提示不会导致遗忘：与我们的准确率匹配的LoRA秩使NaturalBench VQA准确率相对下降35%，在最大秩时上升至56%，而软提示则保持预训练性能不变。
学习到的令牌行为类似于提示而非权重。它们无需重新训练即可迁移至更新的模型（在Qwen3.5-9B上mAP提高0.8），并且可以转化为可读的提示，与提示搜索方法相竞争（匹配DetPO，优于GEPA）。
该方法还可扩展到检测任务之外。在RoboCasa操作任务中，冻结的\( \pi_{0.5} \)视觉-语言-动作策略受益于软提示，当令牌置于梯度瓶颈处时，在三项任务中的两项上匹配LoRA基线。这些结果表明，现代VLMs已经编码了专业领域所需的大部分信息；挑战在于学会如何提问。

title: EVPeriscope: Extended Perception across Aerial and Ground Vehicles with Event-based Propeller Tracking
summary: Reliable relative localization between aerial and ground robots is a key requirement for tightly coordinated heterogeneous teams. This can be difficult to do using conventional frame-based cameras and fiducial markers because they are sensitive to motion blur, lighting variations, and payload constraints. This paper presents EVPeriscope, an event-based perception system that enables detection, localization and control of a quadrotor using an upward-facing event camera on a ground robot by detecting the high-frequency visual signature of its propellers. This system allows the quadrotor to function as an extended perception system for the ground robot when onboard sensors exhibit degradation or occlusion. We demonstrate the capabilities of this marsupial ground-aerial system via experiments in challenging field conditions with wind speeds of up to 15 mph, in both daylight and at night. We show that the system supports localization and closed-loop navigation through dense foliage where the ground robot's sensors are occluded. Our control system for the quadrotor operates at 200 Hz entirely with onboard sensing and computation. More details and experiment videos can be found on the project page: https://ongdexter.github.io/evperiscope.
tldr: EVPeriscope presents an event-based perception system for ground-aerial robot teams, using an upward-facing event camera on a ground robot to track a quadrotor's propellers for reliable relative localization and closed-loop navigation under challenging conditions.
tldr_zh: EVPeriscope 提出了一种基于事件相机的空地机器人协同感知系统，通过地面机器人上的朝上事件相机跟踪四旋翼的螺旋桨，实现可靠的相对定位和闭环导航，适用于恶劣环境。
summary_zh: 摘要：空中与地面机器人之间的可靠相对定位是实现紧密协同异构团队的关键要求。使用传统的基于帧的相机和基准标记难以实现这一点，因为它们对运动模糊、光照变化和载荷限制较为敏感。本文提出了EVPeriscope，一种基于事件的感知系统，通过在地面机器人上使用朝上的事件相机，检测四旋翼螺旋桨的高频视觉特征，实现对四旋翼的检测、定位和控制。该系统使得四旋翼在机载传感器性能退化或被遮挡时，能够充当地面机器人的扩展感知系统。我们通过在风速高达15英里/小时、白天和夜间均具有挑战性的现场条件下进行实验，展示了这种有袋类地面-空中系统的能力。我们证明该系统支持在茂密植被中实现定位和闭环导航，而地面机器人的传感器在此环境中会被遮挡。我们的四旋翼控制系统以200 Hz的频率运行，完全依赖机载感知和计算。更多细节和实验视频可在项目页面查看：https://ongdexter.github.io/evperiscope。

title: ORCH: Organizational Principles Enable Collective Intelligence in Embodied AI
summary: Collective intelligence depends not only on the capabilities of individual members, but also on how those members are organized. Yet artificial multi-agent systems are typically assembled using fixed organizational structures, even when the physical tasks they perform impose fundamentally different coordination requirements. Here we show that principles from human organization theory can be operationalized to organize large, heterogeneous collectives of embodied artificial agents. We introduce ORCH (Organizing Roles and Coordination Hierarchies), which constructs task-specific hierarchical organizations by combining pooled interdependence for work that can proceed concurrently with sequential interdependence for work governed by prerequisite relationships. Across 25 wildfire-response missions spanning reconnaissance, rescue, transportation, resource management, containment and suppression, we evaluated teams of up to 50 heterogeneous agents using eight large language models. Organizations constructed using these principles consistently outperformed four representative embodied multi-agent approaches across mission outcome, execution efficiency, exploration and computational resource use. Human-designed ORCH organizations improved final score by 63.97% and execution efficiency by 74.29% on average relative to the four prior frameworks. Organizations generated automatically by language models improved these measures by 43.63% and 52.53%, respectively. These advantages persisted across missions and underlying language models. Notably, collective performance was not monotonically determined by model scale. Analysis of long-horizon missions showed that hierarchical organization enabled teams to preserve concurrent activity within specialized groups while coordinating ordered transitions between mission phases.
tldr: This paper introduces ORCH, a framework that applies human organization theory to organize large, heterogeneous teams of embodied AI agents into task-specific hierarchies, demonstrating consistent improvements over existing multi-agent methods across simulated wildfire-response missions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ORCH框架，将人类组织理论应用于组织大规模异构具身智能体团队，在模拟野火响应任务中展示了相对于现有方法的持续改进。
summary_zh: 集体智能不仅取决于个体成员的能力，还取决于这些成员的组织方式。然而，人工多智能体系统通常采用固定的组织结构进行组装，即使它们执行的物理任务在根本上要求不同的协调机制。在此，我们展示了人类组织理论中的原则可以被操作化，用以组织大规模、异质性的具身人工智能体群体。我们提出了ORCH（组织角色与协调层级）框架，该框架通过将可并行推进的工作所需的汇总相互依赖性与由先决关系支配的工作所需的顺序相互依赖性相结合，构建任务特定的层级组织结构。在涵盖侦察、救援、运输、资源管理、围控与扑灭等25项野火响应任务中，我们使用八种大型语言模型评估了由多达50个异质性智能体组成的团队。基于这些原则构建的组织在任务成果、执行效率、探索能力和计算资源使用方面，始终优于四种具有代表性的具身多智能体方法。相较于前述四种既有框架，人工设计的ORCH组织在最终得分上平均提升了63.97%，在执行效率上平均提升了74.29%。由语言模型自动生成的组织分别将这两项指标提升了43.63%和52.53%。这些优势在各项任务及底层语言模型中均保持一致。值得注意的是，集体性能并非随模型规模单调变化。对长周期任务的分析表明，层级组织使团队能够在专业分组内保持并行活动，同时协调各任务阶段之间的有序转换。

title: Reflex-Informed Neuromuscular Reinforcement Learning for Muscle-Driven Locomotion
summary: Muscle-driven locomotion provides a physically grounded approach to generating realistic human movement. However, achieving both physiological plausibility and adaptability to changes in musculoskeletal capacity and external disturbances remains a fundamental challenge. To address this limitation, we propose a Reflex-Informed Neuromuscular Reinforcement Learning framework for muscle-driven locomotion. Within this framework, a fixed phase-dependent reflex controller serves as the underlying neuromuscular control mechanism, while the reinforcement learning policy produces four biomechanically meaningful residual parameters to modulate key reflex gains and thresholds associated with hip swing, knee support, and ankle propulsion according to the current state. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework generates physiologically plausible locomotion with improved kinematic accuracy and dynamic consistency, as well as better bilateral symmetry and stride-to-stride consistency under nominal walking conditions. The learned policy remains robust under muscle weakness and external perturbations without retraining.
tldr: This paper introduces a reflex-informed neuromuscular reinforcement learning framework that combines a fixed phase-dependent reflex controller with RL-residual modulation to achieve physiologically plausible and robust muscle-driven locomotion under muscle weakness and external perturbations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种反射信息神经肌肉强化学习框架，将固定的相位相关反射控制器与RL残差调制相结合，在肌肉无力和外部扰动下实现生理上合理且稳健的肌肉驱动运动。
summary_zh: 基于肌肉驱动的运动生成方法为产生逼真的人体运动提供了一种物理上可验证的途径。然而，如何在保持生理合理性的同时，适应肌肉骨骼能力的变化及外部扰动，仍然是一个根本性挑战。为解决该问题，我们提出了一种用于肌肉驱动运动的反射信息神经肌肉强化学习框架。在该框架内，一个固定的相位依赖反射控制器作为底层神经肌肉控制机制，而强化学习策略则生成四个具有生物力学意义的残差参数，根据当前状态分别调节与髋关节摆动、膝关节支撑及踝关节推进相关的关键反射增益和阈值。实验结果表明，所提出的框架能够生成生理上合理的运动，且在标称步行条件下具有更高的运动学精度和动力学一致性，同时展现出更好的双侧对称性和步态间一致性。此外，学习到的策略在肌肉无力及外部扰动情况下依然稳健，无需重新训练。

title: GroundBench: A Factorized, Counterfactual Benchmark for Locating VLM Affordance Failures
summary: A companion evaluation found that naming the target part in a manipulation prompt increased action accuracy by 0.32-0.63 across eight vision-language models, with no model outperforming a constant baseline until the part was named. However, naming the part supplies information that a real system must infer, confounding visual grounding, mechanical reasoning, and category-to-action association. We introduce GroundBench, a diagnostic benchmark that separates these explanations through six branch-and-merge conditions, each adding a controlled information bundle, and a counterfactual re-ask targeting a real alternate part visible in the same image. Across three OpenAI models and 1,068 predictions, supplying the target region without its identity leaves action accuracy at or below the 0.53 majority baseline (0.26, 0.26, and 0.53), although the models largely reproduce the supplied region. Supplying identity without location instead yields 0.74, 0.68, and 0.68. Every above-baseline gain in this curated set occurs where the supplied part category itself determines the action. A no-vision control leaves GPT-5's scores unchanged or improved, providing evidence consistent with substantial category-to-action association. GPT-4o mini declines on one condition, so this interpretation is not universal. Adding joint type and motion axis does not improve accuracy across six model-stratum comparisons. On 74 counterfactual pairs from 32 objects, GPT-5 achieves 0.86 pair-weighted compliance with a 0.07 shortcut rate but fails all observed push-to-lift-vertical cases. GroundBench identifies which supplied information changes affordance behavior and tests whether apparently grounded performance can be reproduced through textual shortcuts.
tldr: GroundBench is a diagnostic benchmark that factorizes VLM affordance failures in manipulation by counterfactually separating visual grounding, mechanical reasoning, and category-to-action association, finding that gains come from category-to-action shortcuts rather than visual grounding.
tldr_zh: GroundBench 是一个诊断基准，通过反事实干预分离视觉定位、机械推理和类别-动作关联，揭示了 VLM 操作能力提升主要来自类别-动作捷径而非视觉定位。
summary_zh: 一项配套评估发现，在操作提示中指名目标部件可将八个视觉-语言模型的动作准确率提升0.32-0.63，且在部件被指名之前，没有任何模型能超越恒定基线。然而，指名部件提供了真实系统必须自行推断的信息，这混淆了视觉接地、机械推理和类别-动作关联。我们引入了GroundBench，一个诊断基准，通过六个分支-合并条件将这些解释分离，每个条件添加一个受控信息包，并通过对同一图像中可见的真实备选部件进行反事实重新询问来测试。在三个OpenAI模型和1，068个预测中，提供目标区域而不提供其身份信息时，动作准确率保持在0.53多数基线或以下（0.26、0.26和0.53），尽管模型在很大程度上复现了所提供的区域。仅提供身份而不提供位置信息时，准确率分别达到0.74、0.68和0.68。在该精选集合中，所有高于基线的增益均出现在所提供的部件类别本身决定动作的情况下。一个无视觉对照组使GPT-5的得分保持不变或有所提高，提供的证据与显著的类别-动作关联一致。GPT-4o mini在一个条件下表现下降，因此这种解释并非普遍适用。添加关节类型和运动轴并未在六个模型分层比较中提高准确率。在来自32个对象的74个反事实配对中，GPT-5实现了0.86的配对加权依从率，捷径率为0.07，但在所有观察到的推-升-垂直案例中均失败。GroundBench识别出哪些提供的信息改变了可供性行为，并测试看似已接地的性能是否可以通过文本捷径复现。

title: Quasi-static analysis of passive stability in a novel underactuated multi-finger hand
summary: Underactuated robotic hands achieve adaptive and robust grasping with a reduced number of actuators, but predicting the stable equilibrium pose of the grasped object remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces a quasi-static analytical approach to assess passive stability in underactuated multi-finger hands. A novel three-finger hand architecture integrating a differential spring-loaded slider mechanism is introduced, enabling versatile and adaptive grasping. The study focuses on how the differential mechanism influences the overall grasp behavior and analyzes the effect of object size on the stable equilibrium configurations for two canonical grasp types: cylindrical and spherical.
tldr: This paper presents a quasi-static analytical model for predicting passive stability in a novel underactuated three-finger hand with a differential spring-loaded slider, analyzing cylindrical and spherical grasps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于预测新型欠驱动三指手被动稳定性的准静态解析模型，并分析了圆柱和球形抓取。
summary_zh: 欠驱动机械手以较少的驱动器数量实现自适应且稳健的抓取，但预测被抓取物体的稳定平衡位姿仍是一项重大挑战。本文提出了一种准静态分析方法，用于评估欠驱动多指手的被动稳定性。介绍了一种新型三指手结构，该结构集成了差动弹簧加载滑块机构，能够实现多功能自适应抓取。研究重点在于分析差动机构对整体抓取行为的影响，并针对圆柱形和球形两种典型抓取类型，探讨物体尺寸对稳定平衡构型的作用。

title: CARLAverse: A Highly Modular, Distributed, and Multimodal Framework for Human-in-the-Loop Simulation
summary: The development of autonomous driving demands comprehensive testing in mixed-traffic scenarios involving vulnerable road users (VRUs), where purely artificial agents often fail to capture authentic human social negotiations. While human-in-the-loop (HITL) simulators enable safe investigation of these interactions, existing multi-agent platforms struggle with the network latency and synchronization constraints required for high-fidelity haptic feedback. To resolve this, we present CARLAverse, an open-source, multimodal simulation ecosystem. Extending modular hardware abstraction, CARLAverse integrates driving (DrivoCARLA), cycling (CycloCARLA), and pedestrian (WalkoCARLA) simulators into a shared virtual environment. Its core methodological contribution is a distributed physics architecture: latency-critical ego dynamics and high-frequency force feedback are computed locally on client nodes, while a central CARLA server orchestrates non-player character (NPC) physics and global traffic. By decoupling haptic control loops from network bottlenecks, CARLAverse enables scalable, cross-institutional HITL experiments without compromising physical immersion. Code and documentation: https://git.ieem-ka.de/simulator-environments/carlaverse
tldr: CARLAverse is an open-source multimodal simulation framework that integrates driving, cycling, and pedestrian simulators into a distributed architecture for human-in-the-loop experiments, decoupling haptic control from network bottlenecks to support cross-institutional studies in mixed-traffic scenarios.
tldr_zh: CARLAverse 是一个开源多模态仿真框架，将驾驶、骑行和行人模拟器集成到分布式架构中，用于人在环实验，通过将触觉控制与网络瓶颈解耦，支持跨机构的混合交通场景研究。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶技术的发展要求在包含弱势道路使用者的混合交通场景中进行全面测试，而纯人工智能体往往无法真实再现人类的社会性协商行为。尽管人在环仿真器能够安全地研究这些交互，但现有的多智能体平台在高保真触觉反馈所需的网络延迟和同步约束方面存在不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CARLAverse——一个开源的多模态仿真生态系统。通过扩展模块化硬件抽象，CARLAverse将驾驶仿真器、骑行仿真器和行人仿真器集成到一个共享虚拟环境中。其核心方法论贡献在于分布式物理架构：对延迟敏感的自我车辆动力学和高频力反馈在客户端节点本地计算，而中央CARLA服务器负责非玩家角色的物理模拟和全局交通管理。通过将触觉控制回路与网络瓶颈解耦，CARLAverse实现了可扩展的跨机构人在环实验，同时不损害物理沉浸感。代码与文档：https://git.ieem-ka.de/simulator-environments/carlaverse

title: SwarmNxt: Open-source Software-Hardware Platform for Fast and Agile Aerial Swarms
summary: Aerial robot swarms have the potential to transform time-critical safety, security, and search-and-rescue operations. By coordinating multiple robots, they can rapidly survey disaster sites, map collapsed or GPS-denied environments, and search cluttered areas faster than a single robot, reducing response times and minimizing risks to first responders. Realizing this potential, however, requires robust autonomous swarm navigation, which remains an active research challenge. Progress is further constrained by existing platforms, as commercial drones are often closed-source or lack the onboard computational resources needed for agile, vision-based collective flight. Moreover, developing, deploying, and maintaining software across multiple aerial robots requires significant engineering effort. To address these challenges, we present SwarmNxt, an open-source software platform built on the open-source OmniNxt drone hardware. SwarmNxt provides an end-to-end toolkit, including detailed hardware assembly instructions with a video tutorial, automation tools for parallel software deployment and swarm-wide updates, and a ROS 2-based framework for autonomous navigation. The platform integrates state-of-the-art control, planning, and depth estimation into a single ROS 2 multi-agent system, providing an open research infrastructure for physical swarm experimentation. We validate SwarmNxt through two real-world experiments: a six-drone swarm performing decentralized planning with high-speed inter-drone collision avoidance, and a four-drone swarm executing collective flight with onboard depth estimation in an obstacle-filled environment. Both experiments were run indoors with global position from external motion capture; perception, planning, and control run onboard.
tldr: SwarmNxt is an open-source software-hardware platform for agile aerial swarms, providing an end-to-end toolkit for autonomous swarm navigation, validated with real-world drone experiments.
tldr_zh: SwarmNxt是一个用于敏捷空中蜂群的开源软硬件平台，提供端到端的自主蜂群导航工具包，并通过真实无人机实验进行了验证。
summary_zh: 空中机器人集群有望彻底改变时间紧迫的安全、安保及搜索救援行动。通过多机器人协同，它们能够比单个机器人更快地勘测灾害现场、绘制坍塌或GPS信号缺失环境的地图，并在杂乱区域进行搜索，从而缩短响应时间并最大限度降低急救人员的风险。然而，要实现这一潜力，需要具备鲁棒的自主集群导航能力，而这仍是一个活跃的研究挑战。现有平台也进一步制约了进展，因为商用无人机通常为闭源系统，或缺乏支持基于视觉的敏捷集群飞行所需的机载计算资源。此外，在多个空中机器人之间开发、部署和维护软件需要大量的工程投入。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了SwarmNxt——一个基于开源OmniNxt无人机硬件构建的开源软件平台。SwarmNxt提供端到端工具套件，包括带视频教程的详细硬件组装说明、用于并行软件部署及集群范围更新的自动化工具，以及基于ROS 2的自主导航框架。该平台将最先进的控制、规划与深度估计集成于统一的ROS 2多智能体系统中，为物理集群实验提供了开放的研究基础设施。我们通过两项真实世界实验验证了SwarmNxt：一项为六机集群执行分布式规划并具备高速机间避碰能力，另一项为四机集群在布满障碍物的环境中执行基于机载深度估计的集体飞行。两项实验均在室内进行，使用外部动作捕捉系统提供全局位置；感知、规划与控制均在机载完成。

title: Morphology-Aware Human Motion Retargeting for Wheeled-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Human-to-humanoid retargeting has largely been studied on legged platforms, while comparatively few wheeled-humanoid systems support coupled locomotion and manipulation from general human motion. Building on GMR's configurable general-motion retargeting and BeyondMimic's physically simulated R1 Pro learning framework, we present a reproducible pipeline that converts multi-dataset SMPLX motion into executable loco-manipulation behavior for the Galaxea R1 Pro wheeled humanoid. The robot has a planar three-wheel base, a serial torso, and two arms but no leg joints, so human lower-body motion must be redistributed across base motion and torso posture without sacrificing manipulation-relevant arm geometry. Our pipeline combines canonical body-shape preprocessing, planar-base normalization, morphology-aware differential inverse kinematics, shoulder-rooted hierarchical arm retargeting, and continuous torso substitution for bending and squatting. A reference-twist-driven planning layer then decodes planar base motion into continuous three-wheel steering and rolling commands subject to hysteresis, kinematic continuity, acceleration, and actuator-rate limits. Finally, a 21-dimensional BaseDecode policy is trained in Isaac Lab with directional joint-limit scaling, focused upper-body tracking, and a staged wheel-contact reward. The resulting system provides a complete bridge from human motion data to physically trackable wheeled-humanoid loco-manipulation rather than a visualization-only retargeter; quantitative policy comparisons remain scheduled for a later revision.
tldr: This paper presents a reproducible pipeline for retargeting multi-dataset SMPLX human motions into physically executable loco-manipulation behaviors for the Galaxea R1 Pro wheeled humanoid, addressing morphology differences via planar-base normalization, differential IK, torso substitution, and a learned control policy.
tldr_zh: 本论文提出了一种可复现的流程，将多数据集的SMPLX人体动作重定向到Galaxea R1 Pro轮式人形机器人的可执行移动操作行为，通过平面基座归一化、微分IK、躯干替换和学习控制策略解决形态差异。
summary_zh: 人形到人形机器人的动作重定向研究主要集中于腿式平台，而支持一般人体动作驱动的轮式人形机器人耦合移动与操作系统的研究相对较少。基于GMR的可配置通用动作重定向框架以及BeyondMimic的物理仿真R1 Pro学习框架，我们提出了一套可复现的处理流程，将多数据集SMPLX动作转换为Galaxea R1 Pro轮式人形机器人的可执行移动操作行为。该机器人具有平面三轮底盘、串联躯干和双臂，但缺乏腿部关节，因此人体下肢动作必须重新分配到底盘运动与躯干姿态中，同时不能牺牲与操作相关的臂部几何构型。我们的处理流程包括：标准人体外形预处理、平面底盘归一化、基于形态差异的逆运动学、肩部固定分层手臂重定向，以及针对弯腰和下蹲动作的连续躯干替代策略。随后，基于参考扭转的规划层将平面底盘动作解码为连续的三轮转向和滚动指令，并考虑迟滞、运动学连续性、加速度以及执行器速率限制。最后，在Isaac Lab中训练了一个21维的BaseDecode策略，采用关节限位方向缩放、重点上半身跟踪以及分阶段轮地接触奖励。所构建的系统为人体动作数据到物理可跟踪的轮式人形机器人移动操作提供了完整桥梁，而不仅仅是用于可视化的重定向工具；定量策略对比计划在后续修订版本中给出。

title: RIDE: Relocalization-Informed Depth Estimation with 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Render--match--PnP relocalization establishes correspondences between query image pixels and 3D map points for camera pose recovery, but their potential to support dense depth estimation is often overlooked. To exploit this geometric information, we present RIDE, which estimates dense metric depth from a robot's RGB stream. Given a metrically scaled 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model, RIDE combines sparse metric depth observations derived from PnP-RANSAC inlier correspondences with the geometric prior of a pretrained video-depth model. To handle uneven and intermittent observations, it integrates global and local depth correction with temporal memory, supporting depth estimation through short observation gaps after metric scale initialization. Trained on public RGB-D videos, RIDE is evaluated on robot sequences without fine tuning. Experiments show improved depth accuracy and temporal consistency over scale-only calibration, demonstrating how localization geometry can support both pose recovery and dense robot perception.
tldr: RIDE leverages PnP-RANSAC inlier correspondences from render-match-PnP relocalization to provide sparse metric depth cues, combined with a pretrained video-depth prior and temporal memory, to estimate dense metric depth for robots from an RGB stream, improving accuracy and consistency.
tldr_zh: RIDE利用渲染-匹配-PnP重定位中的内点对应关系提供稀疏度量深度线索，并结合预训练视频深度先验和时序记忆，从机器人RGB流中估计稠密度量深度，提高了精度和一致性。
summary_zh: 渲染-匹配-PnP重定位通过建立查询图像像素与三维地图点之间的对应关系来实现相机位姿恢复，但其支持稠密深度估计的潜力常被忽视。为利用这一几何信息，我们提出RIDE，该方法从机器人的RGB图像流中估计稠密度量深度。给定一个具有度量尺度的三维高斯溅射（3DGS）模型，RIDE将基于PnP-RANSAC内点对应关系获得的稀疏度量深度观测与预训练视频深度模型的几何先验相结合。为处理不均匀且间歇性的观测，RIDE融合了全局与局部深度校正及时间记忆机制，在度量尺度初始化后，能够跨越短暂的观测间隙进行深度估计。RIDE在公开的RGB-D视频上训练，并在未经微调的机器人序列上进行评估。实验结果表明，与仅进行尺度标定相比，RIDE在深度精度和时间一致性上均有提升，展示了几何定位信息如何同时支持位姿恢复与稠密机器人感知。

title: Freehand Sketching for End-User Programming of Robot Swarms
summary: Robot swarms are increasingly used in applications where accessible interaction with non-expert users is desirable. This paper investigates freehand sketching as an end-user programming interface for specifying robot swarm geometries. Users communicate spatial intent through a drawing, while the swarm autonomously extracts target formation points, constructs a rigid formation graph, assigns robots to formation nodes, and executes distributed formation control with a guarantee against unintended reflected formations. The resulting sketch-to-swarm framework is evaluated through a human study examining the usability of freehand formation specification. Twenty participants generated $42$ geometric shapes, and the interface achieved a mean System Usability Scale score of $84.25$, which conventionally indicates high perceived usability. The results support freehand sketching as an intuitive interaction abstraction for human-swarm collaboration without requiring robotics or programming expertise.
tldr: This paper introduces a sketch-based interface for end-user programming of robot swarms, where users draw target geometries and the swarm autonomously forms them, validated via a human study with high usability scores.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于手绘草图的机器人集群终端用户编程接口，用户绘制目标几何形状，集群自主形成，并通过用户研究验证了其高可用性。
summary_zh: 机器人群体在需要与非专业用户进行可访问交互的应用中日益普及。本文研究了徒手草图作为一种终端用户编程界面，用于指定机器人群体的几何构型。用户通过绘图传达空间意图，而群体则自主提取目标编队点、构建刚性编队图、将机器人分配到编队节点，并在保证避免意外反射编队的前提下执行分布式编队控制。由此形成的“草图到群体”框架通过一项人工研究进行评估，该研究考察了徒手编队指定的可用性。二十名参与者生成了四十二个几何形状，该界面的平均系统可用性量表得分为84.25，按惯例表明其感知可用性较高。研究结果支持徒手草图作为一种直观的交互抽象方式，用于人机群体协作，且无需机器人或编程专业知识。

title: Gait-Dependent Effects on Quadruped Locomotion for Load-Carrying using Passive Mechanism
summary: Passive mechanical interfaces offer a lightweight alternative to actuated manipulators for quadruped payload carrying, but their impedance directly couples the payload dynamics with the locomotion pattern. This paper analyzes how passive-arm stiffness-damping selection affects payload-carrying locomotion under different gait and payload conditions. We compare damped and underdamped passive-arm impedance configurations in simulation during flat-ground locomotion. For crawl gaits, where the support polygon remains well defined, the results show that underdamped impedance increases passive-joint oscillations and can reduce the ZMP margin with respect to the support polygon. Trot is retained as a dynamic excitation case for the passive arm, but it is not used for direct ZMP-margin stability comparison. The results are summarized in gait-payload-stiffness-damping maps, where ZMP-margin reduction is evaluated for crawl gaits and trot is retained only as a passive-arm excitation case.
tldr: This paper analyzes how passive-arm impedance affects quadruped payload-carrying locomotion across different gaits and payloads, showing that underdamped impedance reduces ZMP stability margin in crawl gaits and evaluating trot as a dynamic excitation case.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了被动臂阻抗对不同步态和负载条件下四足机器人负载行走的影响，表明欠阻尼阻抗会降低爬行步态下ZMP稳定裕度，并将小跑步态作为动态激励工况进行评估。
summary_zh: 被动机械接口为四足动物负载运输提供了一种轻量化的替代方案，但其阻抗直接耦合了负载动态与运动模式。本文分析了在步态和负载条件不同时，被动臂的刚度-阻尼选择对负载运输运动的影响。我们通过仿真对比了平坦地面运动中阻尼和欠阻尼被动臂阻抗配置的效果。对于爬行步态，在支撑多边形保持明确的情况下，结果表明欠阻尼阻抗会增加被动关节的振荡，并可能减小ZMP相对于支撑多边形的裕度。快步走被视为被动臂的动态激励案例，但并未用于直接的ZMP裕度稳定性比较。结果汇总于步态-负载-刚度-阻尼映射图中，其中对爬行步态评估了ZMP裕度减小，而快步走仅作为被动臂激励案例保留。

title: LTLDiff: Finite Linear Temporal Logic-Guided Data Generation and Diffusion Policies for Multi-agent Robotic Manipulation
summary: Multi-agent robotic manipulation tasks require coordination among agents to satisfy task-level temporal, logical, and safety constraints. Recently, diffusion policies have been used to perform the task. However, they still suffer from desynchronization, incorrect action ordering, and coordination failures in tasks that require simultaneous or sequential multi-agent interaction. Therefore, LTLDiff is proposed as a framework that combines Finite Linear Temporal Logic (LTLf) specification learning for both the generation of demonstrations and learning via diffusion policies. Each task has a specific LTLf formula that is learned from a set of natural language instructions using a large-scale language model. To enable a fixed-dimensional vector embedding of the learned specification from the language model, LTLf uses an abstract syntax tree representation scheme. This embedding of logic serves as a condition for (i) logic-guided data collection and (ii) diffusion-based policy training, encouraging trajectories that are consistent with the desired ordering and coordination requirements. Experiments on multi-agent LTLDiff manipulation tasks demonstrate improved task success rates compared to the baseline. Together, these contributions demonstrate the effectiveness of LTLDiff for coordinated multi-agent manipulation.
tldr: LTLDiff integrates learned Finite Linear Temporal Logic specifications with diffusion policies to improve coordination and ordering in multi-agent robotic manipulation, achieving higher task success rates.
tldr_zh: LTLDiff 将学习到的有限线性时序逻辑规范与扩散策略相结合，改善了多智能体机器人操作中的协调和顺序，实现了更高的任务成功率。
summary_zh: 多智能体机器人操作任务要求各智能体之间协同配合，以满足任务层面的时序、逻辑及安全约束。近年来，扩散策略已被用于执行此类任务，但在需要同时或顺序多智能体交互的任务中，仍存在不同步、动作顺序错误以及协调失败等问题。为此，本文提出LTLDiff框架，该框架结合了有限线性时序逻辑（LTLf）规范学习，既用于生成示范数据，也用于基于扩散策略的学习过程。每项任务均对应一条特定的LTLf公式，该公式通过大规模语言模型从一组自然语言指令中学习得到。为使语言模型学得的规范能够嵌入到固定维度的向量中，LTLf采用抽象语法树表示方案。该逻辑嵌入同时作为（i）逻辑引导的数据采集和（ii）基于扩散的策略训练的条件，从而鼓励生成符合期望顺序和协调要求的轨迹。在多智能体LTLDiff操作任务上的实验表明，与基线方法相比，任务成功率有所提高。综上，这些贡献验证了LTLDiff在协调多智能体操作任务中的有效性。

title: Topological Necessities: Mechanism-Invariant Strategic Subgoals for Cross-Embodiment Goal-Conditioned Control
summary: Long-horizon goal-conditioned reinforcement learning delegates control to a high-level module that proposes subgoals, but existing subgoals are implicit byproducts of value functions or latent actions, tied to the executor that produced them. We study a different object: a route-conditioned order of unavoidable stages that every successful executor must traverse, recoverable from offline trajectories and belonging to none of them. Its defining properties are topological: an unskippable stage is a separating set that every admissible path must cross, and a loop in free space forces a route choice. We read the two by homology in dimensions 0 and 1 over a transport-weighted carrier built from successful trajectories, yielding an enumerable gate set with shell-level certificates; the certified gates are what we call topological necessities. Certified gates enter the decision loop as a recursive topological gate hierarchy. Under a fixed, isomorphic free space, the object survives executor replacement: gates frozen on PointMaze data transfer without retraining to Ant and Humanoid, attaining the highest Humanoid aggregate under a unified interface (96.1), with +36.0 over a map-privileged reference on the multi-route task (p=1.4e-5); the planner saturates PointMaze (100+/-0) and matches or exceeds the strongest baselines on AntMaze (giant +22.9) and Kitchen (+15.8/+12.6).
tldr: This paper introduces topological necessities—mechanism-invariant strategic subgoals recovered from offline trajectories via homology—that transfer across embodiments for goal-conditioned control, improving long-horizon tasks like AntMaze, Humanoid, and Kitchen.
tldr_zh: 本文提出拓扑必要性——通过同调从离线轨迹中恢复的、跨具身不变的策略性子目标——用于目标条件控制，提升了AntMaze、Humanoid和Kitchen等长时程任务的表现。
summary_zh: 长视野目标条件强化学习将控制权委托给一个高层模块，由其提出子目标，但现有的子目标本质上是价值函数或潜在动作的隐式副产品，与产生它们的执行器绑定。我们研究了一种不同的对象：一种以路径为条件的、所有成功执行器都必须穿越的不可跳过阶段的有序序列，它可以从离线轨迹中恢复，且不属于任何单一执行器。其定义性属性是拓扑性质的：不可跳过的阶段是一个分离集，所有可行路径都必须穿过它；而自由空间中的回路则强制产生路径选择。我们通过同调在维度0和1上，基于由成功轨迹构建的传输加权载体来解读这两类属性，从而得到一个可枚举的门集合及其壳层级证书；这些经过认证的门被称为拓扑必然项。经过认证的门以递归拓扑门层级的形式进入决策循环。在固定且同构的自由空间下，该对象在执行器替换后依然保持有效：在PointMaze数据上冻结的门无需重新训练即可迁移至Ant和Humanoid，在统一接口下达到最高的Humanoid综合得分（96.1），并在多路径任务上比具有地图特权信息的参考方法高出+36.0（p=1.4e-5）；该规划器在PointMaze上达到饱和（100±0），在AntMaze（giant +22.9）和Kitchen（+15.8/+12.6）上匹配或超越最强基线。

title: Testing Between the Test Cases: Proving End-to-End Steering in Conditions You Never Drove
summary: AI-based automated vehicle testing is challenging because a model that passes every test condition can still fail in the real world. Formal verification offers a way to directly address this gap. On a simulated highway and an arterial road we trained two small end-to-end steering networks each in CARLA, one on clear conditions alone and one on clear, fog, night and low sun. All four models were driven against a 2.19 ft lane-departure budget. Without driving again, we used bound propagation, a formal method that reads the trained weights, to compute how far steering can drift at every disturbance strength between two captured images. One calculation covers more than a campaign could drive: on the arterial it spans 133 poses, where ten intensities each would be 10^133 combinations, in minutes on one GPU. Not only did formal verification find conditions that broke the clear-trained policy without simulation testing, it provided some preliminary evidence for potential failures between the test cases. Our overall conclusion is that formal verification is a viable complement to simulation, and could be adopted as a part of verification and validation for automated driving.
tldr: This paper proposes using formal verification via bound propagation on trained end-to-end steering networks to prove lane-keeping performance under untested disturbance intensities, complementing simulation-based testing for automated driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出使用边界传播对训练好的端到端转向网络进行形式化验证，以证明在未测试的干扰强度下的车道保持性能，作为自动驾驶仿真测试的补充。
summary_zh: 基于人工智能的自动驾驶车辆测试面临挑战，因为即便一个模型能通过所有测试工况，在现实世界中仍可能失效。形式化验证为直接弥合这一差距提供了途径。我们在CARLA模拟环境中，分别针对高速公路和主干道训练了两个小型端到端转向控制网络，其中一个仅在晴朗条件下训练，另一个则在晴朗、雾天、夜间和低角度阳光条件下训练。所有四个模型均以2.19英尺的车道偏离预算进行测试。在不进行额外驾驶的情况下，我们利用边界传播这一读取训练权重的形式化方法，计算了在两帧捕获图像之间，每个扰动强度下转向偏移的最大可能范围。一次计算所覆盖的范围远超大规模测试驾驶：在主干道上，该计算涵盖133个位姿，若每个位姿取10种强度，则相当于10^133种组合，而整个过程仅需在一张GPU上运行几分钟。形式化验证不仅发现了晴朗条件下训练的策略在无仿真测试情况下会失效的工况，还为测试用例之间可能存在的潜在失效提供了初步证据。我们的总体结论是，形式化验证可作为仿真测试的有效补充，并有望纳入自动驾驶验证与确认流程的一部分。

title: Planning along Differentiable Charts of Constraint Manifolds with General-Purpose IK Solvers
summary: Planning trajectories for robot manipulators under kinematic equality constraints restricts feasible motions to a measure-zero submanifold of the configuration space, requiring special algorithmic treatment. A promising strategy is parametrizing the set of feasible configurations using analytic inverse kinematics (IK). Bespoke analytic IK functions can be written to be differentiable, a necessary property for gradient-based trajectory optimization. But the vast majority of IK functions are computed by automated meta-solvers like IKFast, and are difficult to modify for differentiability. We present a new approach for computing gradients of analytic IK parameterizations: we leverage the inverse function theorem to recover the desired gradients from the ordinary forward kinematic Jacobian. Furthermore, we present a least-squares domain extension and an optimization-amenable description of the reachability constraint, which preserves gradient signal outside the reachable workspace. We demonstrate the efficacy of our approach through numerical experiments and downstream tasks, including a hardware demonstration of an RB-Y1 picking up a box and placing it on a table. Project website: https://cohnt.github.io/inverse-function-theorem-parameterization/
tldr: This paper presents a method to compute gradients for analytic IK parameterizations of constraint manifolds using the inverse function theorem, enabling gradient-based trajectory optimization for robot manipulators under kinematic constraints, with a hardware demonstration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用逆函数定理计算解析IK参数化梯度的方法，使得在运动学约束下的机械臂轨迹优化成为可能，并进行了硬件演示。
summary_zh: 规划机器人在运动学等式约束下的轨迹，会将可行运动限制在构型空间中的一个测度零子流形上，因此需要特殊的算法处理。一种有前景的策略是利用解析逆运动学（IK）对可行构型集进行参数化。定制解析IK函数可以设计为可微的，这是基于梯度的轨迹优化所必需的属性。然而，绝大多数IK函数是由IKFast等自动化元求解器计算得到的，难以修改以实现可微性。我们提出了一种计算解析IK参数化梯度的新方法：利用反函数定理，从普通正运动学雅可比矩阵中恢复所需的梯度。此外，我们提出了一种最小二乘域扩展以及可优化描述的可达性约束，从而在可达工作空间之外保留梯度信号。我们通过数值实验和下游任务验证了该方法的有效性，包括RB-Y1机器人拾取盒子并放置到桌子上的硬件演示。项目网站：https://cohnt.github.io/inverse-function-theorem-parameterization/

title: Expressive Robotic Pianist: Mastering Complex Piano Repertoire with Graph-Mimic and Musical Dynamics
summary: Enabling robots to perform musical instruments with human-level expressivity represents a frontier in bridging the gap between mechanical precision and artistic interpretation. Despite advances in robotic dexterity, replicating the fluid finger transitions and nuanced dynamic control characteristic of human pianists remains a significant challenge.
